items.task: Finish organization signup and publish the separate public and private repositories.
items.acceptance: Organization ownership and both repository visibility settings are verified after push.
items.result: Organization membership, public/private visibility, default branches, Apache-2.0 license and both initial CI runs verified on 2026-10-18.

items.task: Decide the v0.1 compatibility contract for the newly supplied brief.
items.acceptance: Each contract gap has an explicit implement, reject or defer decision and owner.

items.task: Demonstrate one real skill maintenance repair with reproducible before/after evidence.
items.acceptance: A focused approved repair passes a regression case and records its budget change.

items.task: Walk the maintenance review and recovery experience using the actual product.
items.acceptance: One documented journey quotes observed output, identifies a concrete breakdown and tests a focused improvement.

items.task: Draft a source-backed launch walkthrough for the first developer audience.
items.acceptance: Every product claim has evidence; sensitive paths are redacted; publication remains a separate founder decision.

items.task: Test demand for one recurring team maintenance job before choosing a hosted product.
items.acceptance: Record customer evidence, a falsifiable paid-use hypothesis and a continue/change/stop decision.

items.task: Run a manual xAI function-worker pilot.
items.acceptance: Founder approves provider data scope and budget, credentials are configured, and a bounded proposal is reviewed.
items.blocker: Live API policy is disabled; no API key, model or spending authorization is configured.

items.task: Make the company public and align its operating documents with building in public.
items.acceptance: GitHub visibility is public; the decision, roadmap and publishing boundaries reflect the founder's direction.
items.result: History and workflow outputs reviewed; GitHub public visibility verified on 2026-10-18. Existing company license retained.

items.task: Draft a public walkthrough of how we design roles, maintain living documents and review agent proposals.
items.acceptance: Use actual repository evidence, distinguish the offline prototype from live workers, and identify one organizational experiment to evaluate next. Posting to other channels remains a separate founder decision.
